description: Object key contract shared by the Go file store (apps/api/internal/storage/file.go) and the Python reader (apps/ai-service/app/indexing/file_objects.py). An object lives at <root>/<bucket>/<key>. Both sides must accept exactly the valid keys and refuse every invalid one.
rules: 1 to 512 bytes, at most 8 components separated by '/'
each component: 1 to 128 characters from [A-Za-z0-9._-], not starting with '.' or '-', not '.' or '..'
no empty component: no leading, trailing or doubled '/'
bucket: one component under the same rules
